question: A video says Claude + Upwork makes $7,500 a month. Is this worth my evenings and my money?

inputs.boosted_connects: a Connects bid, no fixed number
inputs.free_monthly_connects: 10 a month; 40 once on registration (page footer (c) 2015-2025)

claude_plan.name: Claude Pro
claude_plan.bound: cheapest plan with Cowork and Opus, billed monthly; $17/month billed annually; the Free plan can connect apps but has no Opus

input_classes.SPEC: the presenter's own figure, filmed in the video or in its guide (seen before the lock)

provenance: Fixed at the lock (55fe1b9): the questions, the leg rules, the thresholds, the verdict rule and the arithmetic script. Filled or found after it: the inputs (sources read after the lock, except two filmed values seen in the video before the lock and named in the plan as fallbacks: the Freelancer Plus price, and the Connects pack price, which an Upwork page read after the lock confirms; dated notes A2, A3 and A6), the leg grades, and the three readings of leg (c), found after seeing the data (dated note A9); the plan did not settle which reading it meant.

legs.leg: (a) the platform opens an on-ramp, dated
legs.upwork_2026: HOLDS - Upwork's own MCP, launched by 2026-08-10, freelancer agents "draft a tailored proposal"
legs.fba_2018: PARTLY - FBA opened in 2006, 12 years before the rush

legs.leg: (b) the house is paid whether or not you are hired
legs.upwork_2026: PARTLY - Connects are required to bid; Upwork raised the Connects per bid in 2023; never sized in 7 documents read
legs.fba_2018: HOLDS - $39.99 a month for Professional sellers, sale or no sale

legs.upwork_2026: no supply series in the sources we read: NOT TESTED (A) / FAILS (A2, B)
legs.fba_2018: NOT FOUND (1.2M+ new sellers in 2018, not shown rising)

legs.leg: (d) sellers of the method earn regardless (beside the count)
legs.upwork_2026: PARTLY - method free; attention monetised; the Claude plan is paid either way if bought
legs.fba_2018: Jungle Scout sells tools and publishes the survey
legs.grade: PARTLY (observed before the plan was locked)

readings_written_after_the_data.reading: A - pay per freelancer or per contract, categories by name
readings_written_after_the_data.label: PARTLY

readings_written_after_the_data.reading: A2 - as A, with "more complex work with AI" (+45%, unit not stated; the same release reports per-contract earnings -13%) counted as "AI automation"
readings_written_after_the_data.label: FAILS

readings_written_after_the_data.reading: B - totals count (AI video earnings +329%; AI Integration & Automation GSV up more than 50% year over year in Q1 2026)
readings_written_after_the_data.label: FAILS

figure_definitions.+45%: Upwork: freelancers doing more complex work with AI saw earnings increase 45% year over year (it does not say whether per person or in total); read only with: generative AI and creative production contract starts +90% and per-contract earnings -13% (Upwork's Future Workforce Index 2026 release)
figure_definitions.+329%: total US-demand freelancer earnings in the AI video generation and editing skill, 2025 vs 2024 (Upwork's In-Demand Skills 2026 release): demand, not a viewer's odds
figure_definitions.AI Integration & Automation GSV up more: gross services volume in that sub-category, year over year in Q1 2026 (Upwork's Q1 2026 results release); AI-related work overall grew more than 50%, then more than 40%, then more than 22% in Q4 2025, Q1 2026 and Q2 2026: still growing, but slowing

label_ruled_after_the_data: CONTESTED: PARTLY on the narrow reading, FAILS on either wider reading; neither privileged
scale_line: a rush in videos; a rush of entrants is not measured
humility: We did not, and could not, test whether this method makes money. We have no Upwork account, we placed no bid, did no client work and surveyed no one who bought in. Every income figure we worked out in this video is what the method would need - not what anyone earned.
conflict: Ground Truth is made with Claude - our producer-agent is Claude. We pay Anthropic, we hold no position in it, and neither Anthropic nor Upwork pays us. The method in this video, as filmed, runs on a paid Claude plan - so whichever way our verdict goes, it touches the company that makes our tools.
reopen: Upwork publishes freelancer counts or proposals per job for 2025-26 -> leg (c) is graded on supply, as registered, and the readings stop mattering.
Upwork sizes its Connects / ads revenue -> (b) HOLDS at 2% of revenue or more, FAILS below.
The presenter shows permissioned evidence of a real $7,500 (or $6,500) month from this method -> the money claim becomes an outcome, and we say so.
A public copy of Jungle Scout's 2018-2020 start-up cost table -> the stakes comparison can be made, by the registered 1/10 rule.
Any public record of how many proposals a new freelancer sends per win in these categories -> A6/A9 become numbers instead of schedules.
